clipboard.copyFailed: Unable to copy automatically. The text is selected; press Ctrl/Cmd+C to copy.
clipboard.copyUnavailable: Unable to copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.

moduleBanner.defaultDesc: While the module is disabled, none of the items below will run. After enabling it, each item follows its own switch.

logViewer.keywordTip: Space-separated terms must all match, double quotes group a phrase, a leading - excludes, e.g. GET "timeout" -debug
logViewer.excludeTip: Hides logs containing any of these terms, combined with the keywords; space-separated, double quotes group a phrase, e.g. debug "health check"
logViewer.ip: IP or range, e.g. 1.2.3.4, 10.0.0.0/8; prefix ! to exclude
logViewer.fieldTip: Click a source or field tag in the log to filter by it; when memory does not hold enough, the history kept in the log files is searched too
logViewer.hideBannedTip: Hide requests from banned sources: requests rejected because the source is banned, and every request from sources that are still banned, including the ones that triggered the ban. Display only: the logs are still kept, untick to see them
logViewer.hideAdminTip: Hide requests that carry an admin console session, such as the log page polling when you open the console through this site. Display only: the logs are still kept
logViewer.exportTip: Export all logs matching the current filters, including history kept in log files and compressed archives
logViewer.resizeTip: Drag to resize the log area; double-click to restore the default height; arrow keys also work when focused

restartOverlay.resumeHint: The page will refresh automatically once the service is back. Keep this page open.
restartOverlay.timeoutDesc: The service has not responded for a long time. If you changed the admin port or listen address, open the new address manually. You can also check the program logs to see how startup is going.

programInstall.title: {name} online install
programInstall.notInstalled: Not installed in {dir} yet; the program from PATH or the set path is used
programInstall.notUsed: {path} is in use; the online-installed version only takes effect when the executable path is left empty
programInstall.proxyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the global update proxy
programInstall.proxyHelp: http, https and socks5 are supported, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Used only to download this program and saved when an install starts
programInstall.backupsHelp: Versions replaced by an update or rollback are kept here, at most {count}, so you can switch back if a new version has problems
programInstall.confirmRollback: Switch to {version}? The current version is kept as a previous version and the related processes restart
programInstall.versionPrompt: Enter the version to install, e.g. v0.65.0 or 2025.8.0. Also works for downgrading
programInstall.confirmUninstall: Delete {files} and all previous versions from {dir}? Processes using it restart and cannot run unless a program of the same name is in PATH. The module settings are kept.

resetConfig.title: Restore default settings
resetConfig.common: Installed programs are kept, and the old settings can be restored from the config history.
resetConfig.frp: This stops all frpc and frps instances, clears the instances, proxies, program paths and the download proxy, and deletes the generated config files.
resetConfig.cloudflared: This stops and deletes all tunnels and clears the program path and the download proxy.
resetConfig.tailscale: This stops all Tailscale instances (a Gately-managed tailscaled using the default state directory logs out first), deletes all instances and program settings, and deletes the login state in the default state directories; custom state directories are kept.
resetConfig.netbird: This stops all NetBird instances (a daemon managed by Gately that uses the default state directory logs out first, removing this machine from the network), deletes all instances and program settings, and deletes the login state and keys in the default state directories; custom state directories are kept.
resetConfig.easytier: This stops all EasyTier instances, deletes all instances and program settings (network secrets included). EasyTier keeps no other state in the config directory.
resetConfig.filebrowser: This stops and deletes all instances together with their users, share links and caches (files in the shared directories are not touched), and clears the program path and the download proxy.
